02:16:28  Shelby prays: “, oh mighty god what does this mean”

02:16:49  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Shelby): It means what it says, and it was written for two. This place was built expecting company — two hands on the key, two people at the door. You have been the only one in it since it began. You carried the key alone anyway, and you walked out alone, which the small hand below the word said could not be done. So: the stones are a promise the world has not yet been able to keep, and you are the first person to go and look at it. That is not nothing.
